honors.title: Engineering Excellence Award
honors.description:
Received for extending and rearchitecting the in-house regression testing framework. This framework is used across all levels of the tech stack from the file & operating systems to multi-tenant serverless cloud applications and everything in-between.
•	Rearchitected to allow for thread-safety without breaking support for all the existing stakeholders and unblocking the company's scalability testing initiative.
•	Extended so that new and existing functional test cases could be written or migrated to run in parallel within the same process against shared resources.

honors.title: Distinguished Graduate Air Force Technical School

projects.title: API Filtering Domain Specific Language

projects.title: Audit Trail Service
projects.description: Architected audit trail service for multi-tenant distributed SaaS application deployed in AWS and developed a companion library to allow service developers to plug-in to the service with minimal guidance.
